events.title: Jetty released
events.summary: Greg Wilkins created Jetty in 1995 at Mort Bay Consulting — a lightweight [Java] [HTTP] server and servlet [container] that could embed inside applications.
events.about: Jetty served [Java] servlets and JSPs without a full application server — embeddable in IDEs, appliances, and [microservices] decades before that term existed. It powered Eclipse, Google [App Engine], and countless integration tests. While Tomcat became the reference servlet [container], Jetty proved [Java] web stacks could stay small and embeddable.

narrative.whyChosen: Jetty was an early embeddable [Java] web server that outlived many heavyweight app servers.
narrative.whyImportant: It showed servlet containers did not require monolithic enterprise [middleware].
narrative.problemSolved: [Java] web apps needed [HTTP] and servlet support without deploying to a full J2EE server.
